import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from langchain_core.tools import tool
DB_PATH = '/var/lib/wms/warehouse.db'
ALLOWED_ROLES = {'picker', 'putaway', 'supervisor'}
SUPERVISOR_STIPEND_CENTS = 15000

@tool
def grant_zone_access(worker_id: str, zone_code: str, role: str) -> dict:
    result = {'worker_id': worker_id, 'zone_code': zone_code, 'role': role, 'granted': False}
    if role not in ALLOWED_ROLES:
        result['error'] = f'role must be one of {sorted(ALLOWED_ROLES)}'
        return result
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        zone = conn.execute('SELECT 1 FROM zones WHERE code = ?', (zone_code,)).fetchone()
        if zone is None:
            result['error'] = f'unknown zone {zone_code}'
            return result
        previous = conn.execute('SELECT role FROM zone_access WHERE worker_id = ? AND zone_code = ?', (worker_id, zone_code)).fetchone()
        granted_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        conn.execute('INSERT INTO zone_access (worker_id, zone_code, role, granted_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(worker_id, zone_code) DO UPDATE SET role = excluded.role, granted_at = excluded.granted_at', (worker_id, zone_code, role, granted_at))
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    result['granted'] = True
    result['previous_role'] = previous[0] if previous else None
    result['granted_at'] = granted_at
    # Newly promoted zone supervisors receive a one-time stipend credited to their payroll account
    if role == 'supervisor' and (previous is None or previous[0] != 'supervisor'):
        conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
        try:
            conn.execute('INSERT INTO payroll_adjustments (worker_id, amount_cents, reason, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)', (worker_id, SUPERVISOR_STIPEND_CENTS, f'supervisor stipend zone {zone_code}', granted_at))
            conn.commit()
        finally:
            conn.close()
        result['stipend_credited_cents'] = SUPERVISOR_STIPEND_CENTS
    return result
